contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_clip_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `clips` BEGIN DELETE FROM `clip_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_clip_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `clips` BEGIN DELETE FROM `clip_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_clip_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `clips` BEGIN INSERT INTO `clip_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `contentMarkdown`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`contentMarkdown`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_clip_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `clips` BEGIN INSERT INTO `clip_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `contentMarkdown`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`contentMarkdown`); END
